Title: Run Azure Load Testing on Azure App Service web apps

Body.Content: You can now create and run load tests directly from App Service in Azure portal. Load test your web apps by simply selecting the deployment slot followed by specifying request parameters and load configuration. You will automatically gain access to client-side and server-side metrics, which will help in identifying performance bottlenecks. You can also view the test run history to continuously monitor their web app performance. Learn more.
